_comment: Registry of the repos github-kit manages. 'base' is the branch the fan-out's update PR targets (a repo's integration branch). 'tier' is the Actions-budget tier the fan-out writes into the repo's CI callers: 1 = CI and verify run automatically on production-bound changes; 2 = they run only when dispatched by hand (see README.md -> 'Repository tiers'). Missing tier = 1. 'fanout': false keeps a repo in the registry for tiering without opening update PRs there (the kit isn't installed yet); install it first, then drop that key and add 'base'. Use each repo's current name: GitHub redirects renamed repos, but a stale name hides which repo is which.
